say:1:1030102701:0.text: What a delight to see you again, Magister.
say:1:1030102701:0.source_cn: 能再次见到你们真是令人高兴，魔法师大人。
say:1:1030102701:0.male: What a delight to see you again, Magister.
say:1:1030102701:0.female: What a delight to see you again, Magister.

say:2:1030102702:0.text: We've always had faith that someone strong and kind would save Ryeham. Someone... Just like you.
say:2:1030102702:0.source_cn: 我们一直相信，迟早会有善良又强大的好人拯救金穗村，就像...
say:2:1030102702:0.male: We've always had faith that someone strong and kind would save Ryeham. Someone... Just like you.
say:2:1030102702:0.female: We've always had faith that someone strong and kind would save Ryeham. Someone... Just like you.

say:3:1030102703:0.text: Anyway, thank you for everything you've done for Ryeham.
say:3:1030102703:0.source_cn: 无论如何，都感谢你们对金穗村的帮助。
say:3:1030102703:0.male: Anyway, thank you for everything you've done for Ryeham.
say:3:1030102703:0.female: Anyway, thank you for everything you've done for Ryeham.

say:4:1030102704:0.text: Things are starting to look up for us, but we should always stay on our guard regardless of whether or not this peace lasts.
say:4:1030102704:0.source_cn: 事态已经开始好转，不过，无论这样的平静是否还能持续，我...
say:4:1030102704:0.male: Things are starting to look up for us, but we should always stay on our guard regardless of whether or not this peace lasts.
say:4:1030102704:0.female: Things are starting to look up for us, but we should always stay on our guard regardless of whether or not this peace lasts.

say:5:1030102705:0.text: After all, there's no telling when bandits or bitter winters will strike next.
say:5:1030102705:0.source_cn: 毕竟谁也无法预料，盗匪或者严寒，是否会卷土重来……
say:5:1030102705:0.male: After all, there's no telling when bandits or bitter winters will strike next.
say:5:1030102705:0.female: After all, there's no telling when bandits or bitter winters will strike next.
